definitions.explanation: Satisfying one's conception of what is best; most suitable.

examples.japanese: {理想的|りそうてき}な⟦{環境|かんきょう}→環境：00174_kankyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{働|はたら}きたい→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
examples.english: I want to work in an ideal environment.

examples.japanese: ⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{理想的|りそうてき}な⟦{解決策|かいけつさく}→解決策：19395_kaiketsusaku⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
{理想的|りそうてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{運動|うんどう}→運動：00821_undou⟧⟦したい→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Ideally, I'd like to exercise every day.

notes:
{理想的|りそうてき} is a na-adjective meaning 'ideal' or 'perfect'—matching one's conception of the best possible.

FORMS:
- Adverb: {理想的|りそうてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (ideally)
- Modifying nouns: {理想的|りそうてき}な + noun

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {理想的|りそうてき}な⟦{環境|かんきょう}→環境：00174_kankyou⟧: ideal environment
- {理想的|りそうてき}な⟦{解決策|かいけつさく}→解決策：19395_kaiketsusaku⟧: ideal solution
- {理想的|りそうてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧: ideally (often starts a sentence)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {理想的|りそうてき}: ideal (may be unrealistic)
- ⟦{現実的|げんじつてき}→現実的：04794_genjitsuteki⟧: realistic, practical

ROOT:
⟦{理想|りそう}→理想：03676_risou⟧ (ideal, dream) + ⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧ (adjectival suffix).
